create_data_loader: create a distributed video data loader for DROID robot trajectory datasets with configurable batch size and frames per clip
build_video_dataset: build a PyTorch dataset that loads video frames, robot states, and actions from DROID trajectory data
run_pose_transform: run pose transformation to convert robot poses from world frame to camera frame using extrinsics
test_pose_diffs: test pose difference computation that converts cartesian positions and euler angles into delta actions
summarize_video_loading: summarize video loading pipeline that samples frames at target fps and extracts synchronized robot state trajectories
